    changeColor(Color) - Method in class Pixie

    State chosen on the most recent brain update.
    currentTarget - Variable in class Organism
    Waypoint currently being walked toward, or null if idle.
    currentYear - Variable in class GameWindow
    Last simulated year for which yearly death lists were flushed.
